Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk me through Crescent Health's primary latency and cost concerns for the member-facing summarization feature. I summarized the options we discussed and attached a pricing deck plus a line-item estimate (attached).

Quick recap:
- Option A: Hosted API (best for fastest launch, lowest engineering lift)
- Option B: Dedicated (predictable capacity, lower per-token cost at scale)
- Optional add-ons: longer retention for audit logs, VPC peering for private deployment

Attachments: CrescentHealth_Redwood_Pricing_Deck.pdf, Estimate_CrescentHealth_v2.xlsx

Would you like me to walk through the deck with the engineering/procurement team? Happy to set a 20–30 minute session to go line-by-line on traffic assumptions and costs. If procurement is the right next owner, I can also share a mutual action plan and expected timelines.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm receipt of the deck/estimate
2) Let me know if you want a walkthrough (I can set times) or if you prefer I loop in procurement

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

Best,
Camila Reyes
